title: Frontend Engineer
text:
Lumina Learning makes interactive math lessons for 2 million students.

The role
- Build accessible, delightful UIs in React and TypeScript with Redux and Tailwind CSS.
- Own our design system in Storybook alongside designers working in Figma.
- Improve performance optimization of large lesson pages (Webpack to Vite migration in progress).
- Write unit tests with Jest and end-to-end tests with Cypress.
- Consume REST and GraphQL APIs from a Node.js BFF.
- Champion accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design across devices.

About you
- 3+ years of frontend experience with React.
- Strong CSS and HTML; JavaScript fundamentals.
- Experience with CI/CD and Git workflows.
- Nice to have: React Native, Next.js, Sentry.
